elements_selected.content:
Implement .zetl-source.toml provenance writing per REQ-014-011.

After clone_theme() succeeds and files are copied to .zetl/themes/<name>/, write .zetl-source.toml:

```toml
[source]
url = "https://github.com/user/repo.git"
ref = "v2.0.0"
commit = "abc1234def5678..."
path = "themes/garden"
installed_at = "2026-03-02T14:30:00Z"
zetl_version = "0.9.0"
```

Public API:
  - write_provenance(theme_dir: &Path, source: &ThemeInstallSource, clone_result: &CloneResult) -> Result<()>
  - read_provenance(theme_dir: &Path) -> Option<ThemeSource>
    (Uses the ThemeSource struct from task-theme-toml-parsing.)

The installed_at timestamp uses UTC ISO 8601. zetl_version is read from env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION").
